name: PSLV-XL
best_known_for: ISRO's heavy-strap-on PSLV variant — launched Chandrayaan-1 + Mars Orbiter Mission
credit: Fleet launcher entry backfilled to wire PSLV-XL up through /plan's view-in-fleet link. First flight = Chandrayaan-1 (Sriharikota SLP, 2008-10-22). Distinct from base PSLV via the larger PS0M-XL strap-on boosters (~12 t propellant each, up from ~9 t on the standard config).

links.l: Mars Orbiter Mission launch (PSLV-C25 / XL) — ISRO
